mods.name: Faded Java Loader Bridge
mods.description: FJL bridge for enabled-mod Java plugin selection, restart checks, multiplayer plugin matching, and the shared FadedStack scheduler and command bus.

mods.name: PZ Optimized
mods.description: Supports exact reviewed Build 42.22.2 game bytes and the complete reviewed optimization payload. Shares startup fingerprints when the Faded Java Loader 0.6.11 opt-in is enabled. Requires Faded Java Loader 0.6.10 or newer and Bridge.

mods.name: Faded Performance Evolution
mods.description: Build 42.22.2 client visuals and performance. 0.3.6 lets players pick 3D Isometric or Vanilla Isometric in multiplayer when the host enables 3D views, and adds near-field 3D grass on OpenGL 4.3 clients. Includes the 0.3.5 server waterworks fix and Down Arrow wiper key. Requires Faded Java Loader 0.6.11 and Bridge.

mods.name: Common Sense Reborn (Test)
mods.description: CSR Test 2.1.6: Fix debug/admin item-list protection loading before the vanilla viewer on B42.21/42.22. Existing features and optional Java bridges retained. 2.1.7 gives the hidden over-the-shoulder VisionBoost items their body location so they cannot throw tooltip errors.

mods.name: GroundWorks
mods.description: Standalone excavation and construction with vanilla tools. Dig outdoors or beneath existing houses; preview and frame preset trenches, moats and basements. Materials and time scale with the footprint. Intact framing prevents collapse. Generate deeper floors and walls, backfill, build routes and integrate optional equipment. All gameplay works through Lua alone. Optional FJL 0.3.4+ companion for PZ 42.20.4, 42.21 and 42.22 adds local cutaways and retains the nearby surface while underground. No ZombieBuddy or PeekAView dependency. Toggle enhanced visibility in Sandbox Options. Foreground structures, lighting and extreme depth can still affect visibility. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.22, 42.21 and 42.20. After an FJL co-op restart, GroundWorks stays in the active mod list.

mods.name: Faded's ClearView UI
mods.description: Build 42.22.2 inventory-argument compatibility, including PZ Optimized character overrides. Existing character, map, inventory, HUD, chat, and storage behavior is unchanged.

mods.name: Deadflow
mods.description: Population authority for new Deadflow worlds on 42.20.4, 42.21 and 42.22 (Windows and Linux dedicated). Stock 42.22 includes reviewed revisions e013dbb529 and 3d39148846. PZ Optimized 0.4.0 and 0.4.1 remain limited to revision e013dbb529. PZ Optimized 0.4.3 is the reviewed full payload for revision 3d39148846 after offline repair. Older saved zombie snapshot formats are not migrated. Requires FJL 0.6.7+ and its fixed Bridge. Uses the shared game-JAR fingerprint with Faded Java Loader 0.6.11 when enabled.

mods.name: CSR Clearview GPS
mods.description: Version 1.3.0. Standalone B42.20 Clearview GPS. Find a rare GPS tablet to open the gunmetal tablet window, plot a purple road route, autodrive, and follow live on network.fadedmods.com/map. Server-authoritative route cache in MP.

mods.name: Tactical Operations Center
mods.description: A server-authoritative admin and player operations suite for Project Zomboid Build 42.20, 42.21 and 42.22. Includes a full Command Center replacement, Covert Event social deduction, location reports, mod-aware Operator and Blueprint tools, CSR authority handoff, FTN trade intelligence, mission routing, Echoes conflict monitoring, scalable 4K UI, and optional FJL/OpenCL dispatch acceleration with Lua fallback.

mods.name: Character Creator
mods.description: Build 42.22.2 creator loading and eye detail update. Background wardrobe indexing, FPE 0.3.3 renderer compatibility and a raised head pose for Faded. 2.7.5 fixes clothing toggles (visor, sleeves, tuck) pointing at missing items and gives seven wearables a registered body location, ending inventory tooltip and right-click errors. 2.7.6 corrects the shoe and boot fitting axis, preserves authored sole and shaft heights, and limits severe skinned garment stretch. 2.7.7 adds separate fits for the seven body profiles, lighter knee-high boots, and tucked camouflage trouser cuffs.

mods.name: Faded's Error Detected
mods.description: Build 42.20, 42.21 and 42.22 diagnostics with ring-safe capture, evidence-only attribution, scalable alerts, searchable reports, and Faded installer update visibility.

mods.name: BuckShot Roulette
mods.description: 1.0.2 adds Project Zomboid 42.22.2 support with a generic Build 42 payload while retaining 42.20. Server-authoritative Buckshot Roulette for one survivor against the Dealer or two nearby survivors; all gameplay and defaults retained.

mods.name: Chocobo Go
mods.description: Chocobo companions, passenger riding, Gysahl farming, breeding and fitted travel gear for Build 42.20.4 through 42.22. Full features require Faded's Java Loader 0.3.4 and FadedJavaLoaderBridge.

mods.name: Last Reins of Knox
mods.description: Eight horse varieties, native care and riding, three craftable horse-drawn carriages, persistent tack and cargo, and an optional NPC cooperation API. Project Zomboid 42.22.2; requires Faded's Java Loader 0.6.4 or later. Development alpha; see included testing scope.

mods.name: MP ChronoController
mods.description: 2.2.1 adds Project Zomboid 42.22.2 support. Retains per-player naps, group sleep acceleration, server time control and all existing multiplayer controls and defaults. Supports Build 42.20.2 through 42.22.2.

mods.name: SentryNet
mods.description: SentryNet 0.1.0-alpha.4: correct B42 vehicle-part iteration and load/teleport guards for bounded storage auditing.

mods.name: KnoxNet OS
mods.description: Build 42.22 networked computer OS with a polished desktop and Hottie Z browser, eight daily gallery picks, expanded image library, native camera and monitor hardware, secure terminal sessions, storage logistics, CCTV alarms and security archives, optional weather, power and plumbing integrations, printing, banking and survivor services.

mods.name: Faded Trade Network
mods.description: Server-authoritative economy, multi-shop commerce, property ownership and leasing, Faction IDs and treasury finance, wealth rankings, and KnoxNet cash integration for Build 42.20 stable. Requires Common Sense Reborn or Common Sense Reborn (Test). Copyright (c) 2026 Faded / Faded Trade Network. All rights reserved; no reupload, redistribution, modpack bundling, forks, or modified releases without written permission.

mods.name: Buildcraft Reborn
mods.description: Build 42.21 and 42.22 three-window Craft / Build / Projects workspace with fast virtual catalogs, full-width project dock, native basements, reconstruction, manufacturing, planning, sewing, home zones, CSR-safe repair ownership, automatic roofing and garage doors, Architect blueprint planning with structure templates, build drafts, door salvage and repair, bank vaults, and an admin world editor. No dependencies. Works with PZ Optimized.

mods.name: Faded Origins - Occupations & Traits
mods.description: 1.0.7 adds Project Zomboid 42.22.2 support with a generic Build 42 payload while retaining 42.20. Server-authoritative Resolve occupations and traits; all existing gameplay and defaults retained.

mods.name: Faded Depths [WIP]
mods.description: WIP Java-first underground expansion for Build 42.20.4 / 42.21.0 / 42.22.0: town sewers, caverns, restored utilities, finite mining, air quality and a custom ClearViewUI-style survey. Server-authoritative SAFE_INSTANCE placement. Requires Faded Java Loader Bridge. Mods= only; never add FadedDepths to Map=.

mods.name: Vehicles by Faded
mods.description: Vehicles by Faded 1.0.4: headlights shine forward from the lamp glass. Per-vehicle shader zone masks and lights; hoods and trunks open upward, doors swing on a vertical hinge; dark window glass; freezer syncs only on change.

mods.name: Echoes of Humanity
mods.description: New Before the Silence worlds start with 10,000 persistent civilians by default. Civilians seek shelter, defend themselves, drive and report incidents to police. The Louisville checkpoint holds into week four, and an optional Project A-Life crossover adds a countywide truce. For Project Zomboid 42.22.2 with Faded Java Loader 0.6.7+ and its Bridge.

mods.name: The Young Died Too
mods.description: Build 42.22 youth zombies and rare baby crawlers/shamblers. PZ Optimized 0.4.1 engine/Lua/animation checks pass. Repairs streamed-object cache retention, stalled playground scans, age-speed recounts and legacy clothing GUIDs; preserves population-neutral conversions and saved identities.

mods.name: Faded's The Hive
mods.description: Server-authoritative zombie ecology with hunts, Living Ladder structures, and controlled population recovery. Version 2.3.9 reduces repeated scheduled work and can use FPE's guarded Lua integration. The Java accelerator remains optional.

mods.name: Water Expanded
mods.description: The comprehensive Build 42 water, plumbing, irrigation and fuel-network overhaul. One server-authoritative WEX graph connects pumps, valves, meters, seep channels, building-wide liquid plumbing, storage, fixtures, gas stations and generators without a bridge hub. Includes calibrated rain collectors, liquid-effect details, mains reconnection, physical petrol routing, portable pumping, quick view, public physical-container API, optional Faded Java Loader acceleration and KnoxNet OS bridge.

mods.name: Solar Never Faded
mods.description: Unified Build 42 power and resilience suite with Classic and Horizon hardware, Sentinel perimeter security, detailed 3D assets, pooled storage, EV charging, water, lighting, three-panel command UI, CSR integration, and KnoxNetOS Schema 2 API.

mods.name: Temp Control
mods.description: Server-authoritative HVAC and central heating: thermostat-controlled AC units plus industrial, home and compact boilers, with CSR/ClearView-styled controls. 1.1.1 makes the daily schedule switch only at its on/off times, so manual toggles and timers are no longer overridden.

mods.name: Faded Skies
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 helicopter flight, utility, and combat systems. Includes the FS UH-1B Iroquois utility helicopter and FS AH-64A attack helicopter. Designed for single-player, hosted multiplayer, and dedicated servers with server-authoritative weapons and noise.

mods.name: RVsReborn
mods.description: RV and Faded Locomotion interiors for Build 42.21 Stable and 42.22 Pre-Release, with server-owned return tracking, utilities, dashboards, and vehicle compatibility.

mods.name: Faded Locomotion
mods.description: A comprehensive Build 42 rail system with multiple trains, detachable rolling stock, bidirectional routes, multiplayer track authority, claims integration, and RV-compatible passenger cars. Version 1.0.0 repairs consist rendering, coupler spacing, turn alignment, carrier scale, force-position synchronization, and first-notch braking, with an optional Faded Java Loader carrier-pinning bridge and a complete pure-Lua fallback.

mods.name: On The Move
mods.description: Qualify bicycle wheel model-part references to the existing Base models for B42.21 held rendering.

mods.name: Project Faded Car
mods.description: Build 42.22 forklift cargo, carry, ladder and roof rack models with case-exact cross-platform asset paths. Tire rack tile page moved to file number 8175 so it no longer collides with Knox Reborn Lite. 2.7.4 fixes fleet vehicle part item types: semi truck front tires use the mechanic-type tire items (no more "Couldn't find item Base.NormalTire"), and double tires, wheel chains, armor, tanks, trailer roof parts and the semi fuel tank no longer get a doubled suffix.

mods.name: Modern EVs
mods.description: Modern EVs 1.0.9: damage shells use the vanilla Veh_Damage textures again so the paint atlas is not sampled through the damage unwrap. The charge stand-in transmits only when its level changes. Engine, battery, muffler, and reservoir are topped up once when a car is first created, and can take damage after that. Generated white wheel discs stay hidden. 1.0.10 adds an empty Base.ChargeStation entity so map-placed vanilla machinery tiles load without "EntityScript not found, script: ChargeStation"; crafted charging stations are unchanged.

mods.name: Faded Vehicles Reborn
mods.description: Build 42.20 MP-centric vehicle lifecycle mod with server-authoritative replacement tickets, B42 timed-action complete hooks, safe spawn scans, admin controls, and CSR compatibility.

mods.name: CAT Construction
mods.description: Sixteen CAT-themed Build 42.20.4 construction vehicles with articulated equipment, working lights, vehicle mechanics, cargo handling, tree and stump clearing, and optional GroundWorks integration. Version 0.3.0 adds earth scooping, direct truck transfers, corpse collection, interchangeable crane tools, house demolition, visible tipper loads and dumpster fill.

mods.name: Military Vehicles Reborn
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 military vehicle pack by Faded. 21 vehicles and paint variants: Humvees, Abrams, Bradley, MRAP, cargo trucks, M109A3 artillery, M270 MLRS and M142 HIMARS. Version 2.1.1 finishes tan M1A2 and HIMARS paint, detail and shading, and increases both MRAP variants by 8%. Rigged guns and access parts, military dashboards, and server-controlled ordnance.

mods.name: Faded's Ride or Rot
mods.description: Preserve the B42.21 mechanics action constructor parameter names and order.

mods.name: Faded's Advanced Medical
mods.description: FAM 2.3.0 for Build 42.20.2+: timestamped medication coverage, compression and immobilization care, wound visuals, expanded arm prosthetics, and a polished three-sided triage workspace with reduced background work.

mods.name: Faded Farming & Fishing Reborn
mods.description: Unified B42.22 farming, fishing, orchards, husbandry, brewing, hydroponics, food production, carts, wheelbarrows, and farm vehicles with a scalable field console. Server-authoritative multiplayer actions; optional Common Sense Reborn integration. Shopping cart meshes load on Windows and Linux without a pipe-node path.

mods.name: Just2Faded
mods.description: Standalone cultivation, processing and laboratory expansion. Grow tents, hydroponics, powered drying, named blends, reusable smoking pieces, vacuum storage, and integrated 3D laboratory assets.

mods.name: Parent's Journal
mods.description: A keepsake from home. Every survivor starts with Dad's Journal or Mom's Journal. Use it once to answer a few questions about your parent and receive bonus skill experience and personality traits based on your choices. The journal is consumed after you submit your answers.

mods.name: Salvaged Fuel Recovery Station
mods.description: Commission a fixed industrial generator and nearby tanks or barrels to manufacture and store gasoline or propane. Gasoline requires a hose and compatible container to recover; propane requires an empty propane tank.

mods.name: My Only Friend
mods.description: My Only Friend 3.0.1 for PZ 42.22.0: 20 original low-poly ground models with FBX resolver compatibility, real UV islands and matching per-item PNGs; separate fitted worn gear. Requires FJL 0.6.7 on server and clients. Compatible with PZ Optimized 0.4.1. 3.0.3 moves the companion command wheel key off K (now Apostrophe).

mods.name: Never Survive Alone
mods.description: 0.7.1-alpha fixes poster-wall opening checks for the 42.21 door/window API. Server-validated, explicit-opt-in adult intimacy, player scenes, Echoes NPC partner shared rest, wardrobe, Lifestyle and CSR Survivor Bond integrations remain available.

mods.name: Faded's Hunters Calling
mods.description: A comprehensive Build 42.20.2-42.22.0 hunting system with a responsive three-pane fieldbook, wild boar sounders, game feeders, a hunting tripod, wind-aware scent, a charcoal smokehouse and game cellar, five.308 rifles, four bows, native Crafting and Building tabs, tracking with an optional Java accelerator and complete Lua fallback, field dressing, preservation, calls, scents, trapping, and multiplayer-safe administration. Includes CraftBench leather/plant racks and a kiln rack for dedicated MP, where vanilla drying racks do not finish.

mods.name: The Price We Pay
mods.description: Build 42.20 server-authoritative SP/MP arrest, restraint, escort, and prisoner transport mod.

mods.name: Skill Book Expansion
mods.description: Adds the missing Build 42.20.2 skill books and book sets for Axe, Long Blunt, Short Blunt, Short Blade, Spear, Nimble, Sprinting, Sneaking, Lightfooted, Fitness, and Strength.

mods.name: Faded's Lifestyle: Hobbies (All-in-One B42.20)
mods.description: Preserve all original crafting return values and qualify the custom chainsaw held model.

mods.name: Faded Legendary Kit
mods.description: Preserve every original crafting return value while retaining legendary crafting effects.

mods.name: Authentic Z
mods.description: Build 42.22 sleeping bag, Left 4 Dead hand and Pinhead mask mesh repairs with original textured models and exact cross-platform asset paths. Compatible with Faded Java Loader 0.6.7 and PZ Optimized 0.4.1. 42.22.1 registers the Gibus hat and HairStyle34 wig on AZ body locations and points body-size model toggles at Base items.

mods.name: Faded's Armor Pack
mods.description: Build 42.22.2 armor overhaul with rebuilt 3D fits and textures, powered night vision, equipment loot by location, role-based zombie outfits, and optional adaptive body fitting.

mods.name: Faded Arsenal: Dead County Munitions
mods.description: Doubles Arsenal weapon damage, quiets suppressed reports and zombie attraction, restores menu sprites, and enables bulk ammo opening with Common Sense Reborn Main, Test, or the standalone Arsenal menu. For Project Zomboid Build 42.22.2. Faded's Java Loader enables runtime fixes and barrel effects.

mods.name: Spongie's Open Jackets
mods.description: Alternate wearable styles for vanilla clothing, updated for Build 42.20.2.

mods.name: Spongie's Clothing [B42 Port]
mods.description: Build 42.20 compatibility port of Spongie's Clothing (21.42.20.5). Fixes body-location hide-model overrides without Java reflection (no getDeclaredField crash on 42.20.2). Original mod by Spongie; port prepared by Faded with permission/request from the original developer.

mods.name: Faded's Feastcraft
mods.description: Native kitchen recipes, portion-aware cooking, distinct placeable food models, refreshed blue three-window UI and bounded multiplayer work.

mods.name: Faded Field Operations
mods.description: Campaign expansion 2.0.5. Requires Echoes 0.17.4+, Faded Java Loader 0.5.0+ and FadedJavaLoaderBridge on client and server. The Java core loads on 42.20, 42.21 and 42.22. 2.0.9 moves the campaign journal key off K (now Backspace). 2.0.10 stops Dead Stash special-zombie drops from being sent to a removed zombie's container (ContainerID o.square null); drops are unchanged.

mods.name: Proximity Auto-Read
mods.description: Choose focused literature types or read every nearby unread knowledge item. Separates knowledge magazines from leisure magazines and uses Build 42.20 native read state and timed actions.

mods.name: It's A Trap!
mods.description: Build 42.21 cook-off ammo hotfix: tag checks use ItemTag objects instead of strings, so the hot-ammo server tick no longer throws on pots or other items in ovens, BBQs, fireplaces and campfires.

mods.name: The Path Less Traveled
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 native Skills-tab progression from level 10 to 15 with ClearView-style mastery cells and server-authoritative permanent category buffs.

mods.name: Faded Beds Have Blankets
mods.description: 1.2.7 reserves a distinct heated-blanket tile-definition number for compatibility with Water Expanded. Removable blankets, fifty heated quilt sets, larger pillows, bed warmth, and restful covered-bed sleep for Build 42.21. Existing sprite and item names are preserved.
